text:
maria: Quick design review — dropped a new Figma link for the routing policies editor iteration: https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ-mini-map-sim
sam: skimmed. love the mini-map idea for long rule stacks — helps orientation when preview is on the right :thumbsup:
kevin: question: does the mini-map reflect collapsed groups and inline simulations? or only the canonical stack view?
maria: it'll reflect collapsed groups; the intent is to show a condensed stack state and current viewport highlight. clicking a region should jump the editor to that block.
ashley: a11y note — mini-map needs a textual label/landmark and a way to focus it with keyboard. screen reader should announce "Rule stack mini-map, x groups, viewport on group 3" @a11y-bot
a11y-bot: [automated] Accessibility checklist: mini-map role=button? region? Recommend role="application" + aria-label + keyboard focusable. Provide skip link target to main editor view.
jordan: UX nit — the mini-map hover shadow is too strong, hides the preview edges. can we dial opacity to 12%?
sam: also the preview scrubber (simulation timeline) — right now the scrubber handles block-level simulation only. want it to support token-level scrubbing? might be heavy.
kevin: for perf, token-level scrubbing is risky. propose coarse scrubbing (per-rule / per-snapshot) and a detailed "replay" mode that streams the actual token timeline when user requests it.
maria: decision idea: default scrubber = per-snapshot (fast). "Replay" button streams native token timeline in a modal with play/pause and speed control.
ashley: copy suggestion for the replay CTA: "Replay full token timeline" -> shorter: "Full replay" (keeps toolbar tidy).
sam: validation lifecycle: currently the editor runs 3 validators: schema, runtime compatibility, and preview-sanity. Error toasts are ephemeral & conflict with the simulation controls.
jordan: I've seen users miss toasts a lot. We should surface persistent inline validations on affected rule cards, with a subtle top-banner summary for the entire policy.
kevin: engineering concern — inline validators will need stable anchors for dynamic ordering. we can render validators inside the card and collapse them behind a "show details" chevron.
maria: agreed. UX proposal: show a red badge on rule card if failing, with hover summary. clicking opens inline validator pane with details and suggested fixes.
ashley: a11y: badges need text alternatives like "Rule failing: missing target" and keyboard focus order must ensure validator pane receives focus when opened.
a11y-bot: [automated] Focus trap recommended for validator pane; ensure Escape closes pane and returns focus to the triggering badge.
sam: preview shadow + iOS PWA weirdness — reported that when preview is toggled, the focus jumps to the preview iframe causing keyboard nav to break. Need to ensure focus stays in editor unless user explicitly focuses preview.
kevin: implement focus guard: after toggling preview, call editor.focus() and set aria-hidden on the preview iframe until user tabs into it.
jordan: microcopy: error copy for the top-banner — current "Policy invalid" feels abrupt. suggestion: "Validation found issues in this policy — click to review" (actionable, less scary).
maria: agree. I'll update copy. also add an inline CTA: "Run quick-sim" that re-runs preview-sanity after fixes.
sam: visual: when rules reorder, animation should keep the mini-map viewport synced. Right now it jumps and feels disorienting.
kevin: we can animate viewport translate based on delta of card positions. cost is minor but need precise layout metrics. ok from infra side.
ashley: keyboard nav for reorder (grab + move) — add aria-live announcements: "Moved rule 3 to position 1". This helps screen reader users confirm changes.
a11y-bot: [automated] Announcer pattern: use aria-live="polite" for non-critical movement; provide an optional verbose mode for more context.
jordan: one more UX edge: when a rule has a fallback (automatic model downgrade), the preview should show both primary and fallback outputs in a collapsible diff.
sam: +1 for diffs. lightweight diff inline would be great: left=primary, right=fallback, metric badges (latency, cost delta, token count).
kevin: backend will need to return paired outputs for simulated traffic. we'll add a /simulate?include_fallbacks=true flag. sample when testing:
```
GET /api/policies/123/simulate?include_fallbacks=true
200 {
  "snapshots": [ { "id": "s1", "primary": "...", "fallback": "...", "metrics": {"latency_ms": 120, "cost": 0.006} } ]
}
```
maria: action items:
- sam: tweak mini-map opacity + hover behavior (small)
- kevin: add focus guard + simulate include_fallbacks flag
- ashley: write keyboard/a11y checklist for mini-map, validator pane, and reorder announcer
- jordan: prototype inline diff in figma
- maria: update copy for top-banner and replay CTA
sam: I'll open a quick PR for CSS tweaks and the replay CTA copy change.
kevin: I'll stub the simulate flag in the test API and add docs for the payload shape.
ashley: will post the a11y checklist in this thread once done.
maria: thanks all — want to ship the mini-map + inline validators in the next sprint. If no blockers, I'll mark as "design-approved" and schedule a follow-up conv for engineering estimation.
sam: design-approved (pending small css tweak)
kevin: no blocker from infra, will estimate once API stub is merged
jordan: will share prototype by EOD tomorrow
ashley: a11y checklist incoming :ok_hand:
a11y-bot: [automated] Thread summary: mini-map, simulation scrubber behavior, inline validator pane, persistent top-banner, focus management, replay modal, paired fallback diffs."
